authorization: User selected same-model interventions plus 45 training-recipe sensitivity fits in this conversation. No 30-fit recording decomposition, temperature calibration, new backbone, new cohort or cloud startup authorized by this plan.
status: Specified after v21 outcomes and reviewer suggestions were known; not preregistered or independent confirmation

new_recipe.sampling: shuffle without replacement; every training image once per epoch

common_training.checkpoint: first maximum inner-selection BACC; no outer/external use

interventions.sex_unknown: Replace sex columns with [0,0,1] for every case; leave age and age-missing indicator unchanged
interventions.sex_recorded_permutation: 100 label-agnostic permutations among female/male recorded cases only; retain all unrecorded positions. Shared case indices across arms and seeds. Internal permutations stay within each held-out outer fold; external permutations are shared across all fold models.
interventions.image_only_policy: Verify ordinary predictions for all image-only checkpoints; metadata ignored by construction and perturbed spot checks. Reuse unchanged reference responses rather than claim repeated neural perturbation runs.

inference.cache_gate: Every case observed cached/direct/reference agreement plus unknown and permutation direct spot checks. Fail closed on disagreement.

statistics.primary_recipe_sensitivity: Change with recipe in the external-minus-internal full-minus-image_only BACC contrast
statistics.recipe_pairing: Restrict old recipe to same first three seeds, folds and patients; keep original five-seed v21 results untouched
statistics.patient_cluster_pairing: Independent cohort resampling; same within-cohort patient draws across recipes, models, seeds and intervention conditions; no model-fit resampling
statistics.fold_weights: Retain original per-class outer-fold support weights for external recalls/BACC; image-count fold weights for NLL, Brier and overall prediction flips. No probability ensembling.
statistics.intervention_permutation_summary: Average repetitions within each seed first; seed SD across five seed means. Distinguish permutation SD of five-seed means and MCSE/10. Patient intervals condition on the fixed repetitions.
statistics.multiplicity: Descriptive unadjusted percentile intervals; no result-dependent stopping
statistics.scope: Joint loss+sampling recipe sensitivity, not separate loss/sampler causation; input responses do not establish recording causes or clinical benefit.

resume: Completed model/cohort artifacts verified and skipped. Interrupted incomplete new training attempts are retained and the affected fit restarts from its original seed; completed fits never rerun. This is fit-level resume, not exact mid-epoch resume.
completion: Freeze all 45 new fits before any outer-test or external evaluation. Keep best weights locally; return summary archive, intervention logits/probabilities, logs, configs, histories, checkpoint inventory and progress.
